entries.name: Zebra crossing
entries.description: Transverse stripes marking a pedestrian crossing where pedestrians have priority.

entries.name: Stop line
entries.description: Solid transverse line indicating where vehicles must stop.

entries.name: Give-way marking
entries.description: Transverse broken line and/or triangle marking indicating where to yield.

entries.name: Broken lane line
entries.description: Dashed longitudinal line separating lanes; lane changes permitted with care.

entries.name: Solid lane line
entries.description: Continuous longitudinal line discouraging or prohibiting crossing.

entries.name: Double solid line
entries.description: Double continuous centre line prohibiting crossing in either direction.

entries.name: Centre line
entries.description: Line separating opposing traffic flows.

entries.name: Edge line
entries.description: Continuous line marking the edge of the carriageway.

entries.name: Direction arrows
entries.description: Pavement arrows indicating permitted movements from a lane.

entries.name: Yellow box junction
entries.description: Yellow cross-hatched box that must not be entered unless the exit is clear.

entries.name: Chevron and hatch markings
entries.description: Diagonal or chevron markings separating traffic or protecting a hazard.

entries.name: Bus lane
entries.description: Lane reserved for buses, identified by a legend and lane line.

entries.name: Cycle lane
entries.description: Lane reserved for cyclists, identified by a bicycle symbol.

entries.name: Speed-limit pavement marking

speed.notes: Pavement legend repeats a posted limit; RVHL reads the value only from the detected legend or map data.

entries.description: Speed number painted on the pavement repeating the posted limit.

entries.name: School marking
entries.description: Pavement legend warning of a school zone.

entries.name: Rumble strips (marking)
entries.description: Raised transverse thermoplastic bars producing audible and tactile warning.

entries.name: Raised road studs
entries.description: Raised pavement markers (cat's eyes) supplementing lane lines at night.

entries.name: Reflective markers
entries.description: Retroreflective markers delineating lanes, edges or hazards.

entries.name: Faded markings
entries.description: Worn markings that are hard to see, especially at night or in rain.

entries.name: Missing markings
entries.description: Section where required markings are absent.
